description: Returns live aggregates of French public procurement contracts for websites (DECP open data, plus BOAMP price weighting) from the Les Créavores open dataset: amounts excl. VAT (n, q1, median, q3) per 'category|buyer type' (website creation/redesign, maintenance/hosting, SEO/marketing), number of bids received, yearly breakdown and publication thresholds. Optional filter by buyer type (e.g. commune, departement, region, epci_syndicat, universite, hopital_etab_sante, autres, tous). Every answer carries sources, licence, generation date and citation.

buyer_type.description: Buyer type as written in the dataset, e.g. commune, departement, region, epci_syndicat, universite, hopital_etab_sante, autres, tous

include_unpublishable.description: Also return cells flagged publiable=false (default false)

name: get_marches_publics
